findings.title: The third plan card breaks the shared line of the prices

location.description: The three plan cards under the Plan heading, the third card (Packer) and its monthly price

findings.viewer_experience: The description in the third card wraps onto a second line, so its price sits lower than the prices in the other two cards and the row of three cards looks uneven.

current.value: The description in the third plan card runs onto two lines and its price sits about one line lower than the other two prices.

findings.target: The three monthly prices sit on one line across the three cards, and each description fits on one line.
findings.fix_direction: Make the third card's description fit on one line so the three prices line up.
findings.source: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Visual Design

closed_when.check: Look at the three plan cards: the three prices sit on the same horizontal line and no description wraps.
